title: Fix wrong color space on Wayland with NVIDIA
summary: If colors look dark on Wayland with HDMI, force the correct color space via a kernel parameter.
error_patterns: Wrong color space on 60Hz on Wayland with HDMI

steps.explain: Add the kernel parameter nvidia-modeset.debug_force_color_space=2 to your bootloader configuration.

rollback.explain: Remove the kernel parameter from the bootloader configuration and reboot.

warnings: This is a debug parameter and may affect color accuracy on other displays.
